title: SIT directs Ram Temple trust officials not to leave Ayodhya as donation probe continues
summary: The investigation into alleged embezzlement of Ram Temple funds has escalated, leading a Special Investigation Team to restrict trust and temple officials from exiting Ayodhya. As discrepancies surface, investigators are meticulously analyzing donation records, which include valuable items.
